svg.title: ELMo gives a word a vector from its context
svg.desc: A static embedding gives the same vector to both uses of bat. ELMo runs a frozen forward and backward LSTM over the sentence, then learns task-specific weights over layer states to produce a contextual token vector. ELMo is LSTM-based, not a Transformer.

g.text: ELMo gives a word a vector from its context
A frozen bidirectional LSTM reads the sentence; a task learns how to mix its layers.
“A bat flew from the cave.” → v_bat
“He hit the ball with a bat.” → same v_bat
One vector per word cannot separate
contextual vector. ELMo is not a Transformer.
